crops.reading: As the 450: yellow crescent up each outer edge from the roof shoulder, a yellow panel under each screen holding three lamps (headlamp inboard, marker outboard, red tail below between), gangway in a weathered frame, door black over yellow with four panels; navy above, numbers white over the screens.
Headlamp inboard (larger, clear), dark marker outboard about 0.6 of its size at the same height, red tail below between; flush, black rings.

As the 450: the yellow a 'C' (outer band rounded at the top, panel under the screen to the lamp bottoms, rounded lower outer corner); headlamp inboard, marker outboard slightly higher, tail below between; wiper pivoted bottom-inboard; bellows full height beside the door (reader 2).

Crescent widest at about window height, convex rear edge, ending rounded just below the lamps; cab door navy, outlined by grooves, rounded top-rear corner, window half its width toward its rear edge in two panes; the SWR logo between the cab door and door 1; the cantrail line runs back from door 1 only (reader 2).

Single pale grey leaf, sky-blue band over the top, yellow outline all round: thin full height in front, wide on the rear edge for the top 40% (with 'First Class'), then thin to the bottom; window from 15% to 60% of the leaf height (reader 2).
Cab door: narrow two-pane window offset toward the rear edge, no yellow on the door (reader 2).

crops.feature: diagram: cab end to the windows

crops.reading: White with a navy band and yellow bottom line; two single navy doors with blue top bands, seven windows between them and three after (reader 2).
